timing_verdict.label: BAD
timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: BAD timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: ~1,400 KRW/USD

WHY: The won has strengthened significantly (8.8% appreciation in July alone), pushing the exchange rate down from ~1,600 to ~1,400 KRW per USD. A lower KRW/USD rate means you need fewer won to get your $2,000, but the news suggests this favorable trend may have already peaked—one source warns "long-term high exchange-rate phase continues," implying further won strength is unlikely.

TIP: Consider locking in this rate soon if possible, or dollar-cost average your monthly conversion rather than waiting for rates to weaken further, since the won appears to have completed a major appreciation cycle.
